newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Erste leaves Creditanstalt bidding group - source.
newsitem.headline: Erste leaves Creditanstalt bidding group - source.

text.p: VIENNA, Sept 6 (Reuter ) - Austrian savings bank Die Erste has left an Austro-Italian-German group bidding for privatisation candidate creditanstalt, sources close to the negotiations told Reuters on Friday.
Austro-Italian insurer EA-Generali, who heads the consortium, would now prepare its own independent offer for the flagship bank, the source said.
"The consortium wanted to go it alone," the source said.
No official confirmation from the key members of the consortium or the Austrian Finance Ministry, in charge of the sale, was immediately available.

Members of the consortium have been at odds over Die Erste's proposal to form a joint holding with Creditanstalt in which the savings bank, barely a third the size of Creditanstalt, would hold a controlling stake.

The Austrian government has given the group until midnight Friday to submit an offer. Finance Minister Viktor Klima has said he'll reopen the privatisation process for other bidders on Monday if the consortium fails to comply. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
